CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.record_admin_login_failure(p_ip inet, p_device_id uuid, p_now timestamp with time zone DEFAULT now())
 RETURNS TABLE(allowed boolean, wait_seconds integer, failure_count integer, suspicious boolean)
 LANGUAGE sql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  select * from private.record_admin_login_failure(p_ip,p_device_id,p_now)
$function$

functions.name: has_staff_role
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.has_staff_role(p_role staff_role DEFAULT NULL::staff_role)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  select exists (
    select 1 from public.staff_members s
    where s.user_id = (select auth.uid()) and s.active
      and (p_role is null or s.role = p_role)
  );
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.login_rate_limit_key(p_ip inet, p_device_id uuid)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE
AS $function$
  select coalesce(p_ip::text, '') || '|' || coalesce(p_device_id::text, '')
$function$
